dueDate.title: Due Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dueDate.description: Due date for tasks. If rep says 'kal' = tomorrow, 'is hafte' = this week (Friday), 'agle hafte' = next week Monday, 'agle mahine' = first of next month. Default = 3 business days from today.

followUpActions.title: Follow-Up Actions
followUpActions.description: Comma-separated list of ALL follow-up commitments. Be specific and actionable. Parse Hinglish: 'bhejna hai'=send, 'arrange karna hai'=arrange, 'call karna hai'=call, 'milna hai dobara'=revisit, 'bhejunga'=will send, 'share karunga'=will share. E.g. 'Send Keytruda KEYNOTE-189 data to Dr. Sharma, Arrange CME at Apollo next month, Call back Friday to confirm formulary decision'.

physicianName.title: Physician Name
physicianName.description: Doctor the tasks are for. Links to today's visit report.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: High / Normal / Low. Use High only if rep says urgent/jaldi/ASAP. Default Normal.
